sections.title: I. Read the text. Choose the best word (A, B, C, or D) for each space.
sections.introHtml:
MY NEW FRIEND

Kim is a new girl in my class. We're friends now. Kim is tall with (21) _________ blond hair and blue eyes. We (22) _________badminton together after school. At school, she always wears a uniform but today is Saturday so she (23) _________ a yellow T-shirt and pink sneakers. I think Kim is very funny and kind, and she thinks (24) _________other people. We are going shopping at the mall this afternoon because she's having a party tonight. After that, we are making pizza for the party and watching TV. Tomorrow we are (25) _________swimming at the beach.

sections.title: II. Read the text about Simon. Choose the correct answer (A, B, C, or D). (1 point)
sections.introHtml: I really like art, English, and literature. They're really interesting and can be fun. I don't like math, geography, or science. They're boring. My favorite subject at school is literature. I like learning about stories of people from different places and times. My favorite book is The Secret Garden. The author is Frances Hodgson Burnett. The girl in the novel, Mary Lennox, goes to live at her uncle's house and discovers a secret garden. She becomes friends with Dickon and her cousin Colin Craven. They often play together and take care of the garden. It's a very interesting story and I really love their friendship.

sections.title: IV. Write a passage about 40-60 words about your house. (1pt)

questions.html:
You can use the following questions as cues:

1. Where do you live?

2. How many rooms are there in your house?

3. Which room do you like best in your house? Why?
questions.referenceHtml:
1. Format: (0.1 point for correct format). One paragraph only with the introduction, the

body, and the conclusion.

2. Content: (0.4 point): a provision of main ideas and details as appropriate to the main idea.

3. Language: (0.3 point): a variety of vocabulary and structures appropriate to the level of secondary students.

4. Presentation: (0.2 point): Coherence, cohesion and style appropriate to the level of

secondary students.

I live in a lovely house in Nam Dinh with my family. There are six rooms in my house: a living room, a kitchen, three bedrooms, and a bathroom. My favourite room is my bedroom because it is bright, quiet, and comfortable. Besides, I often study, read books, and relax there after school. I really love my house because it is a happy place for my family
